tooltips.matchedWhereExpression: An ExpressionLanguage expression with access to `stageEntity` (a hydrated record). Must return a where-clause array describing which master records to consider as candidates - keys are field names, values are what to match against (operators can be embedded in the key, e.g. `field>`, `field*`, and `OR`/`AND` groups nest for more complex conditions) - e.g. {nameFrFr: stageEntity.get('name')} finds master records whose nameFrFr equals the stage record's name.
